name: Grudda Four-Bowls

Grudda Four-Bowls (CE)

Grudda is an exceptionally large and aggressive hill giant matriarch who commands the allegiance of several Broadmaw families. Her authority rests upon her strength, appetite, and reputation for defeating rival chiefs. She regards smaller peoples as convenient sources of food and tribute, and frequently organizes raids against settlements in the foothills. Grudda has become particularly interested in the enormous cattle herds maintained by the ranchers of Redvale.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 59 (source excerpt; may be partial)
